item.title: Losing our cold

item.title: More Dogs on Main: Some days are like that
item.description: "Looking in the rearview mirror, the alpenglow on the peaks to the east was like fire. I pulled over in a spot with a clear view and got out of the car to gawk until it vanished. It may have been one of the best sunsets I’ve ever seen." The post More Dogs on Main: Some days are like that appeared first on Park Record.

item.title: Betty Diaries: A day in the life of an unmarried Park City tradwife
item.description: "These tasks I perform alone. There is no husband waiting by the hearth, no domestic audience to whom the day’s account must be given. Amidst the steady quiet, I am met only by the muffled snoring of my four-legged fur child curled in his well-tended bed."
